openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: SCOPe REST API
  version: v1
  description: >
    Read-only JSON API for low-cost SCOP/ASTRAL/SCOPe lookups, release-scoped
    hierarchy traversal, indexed search, static-download manifests, and
    paginated collections. Biological data endpoints are release-scoped for
    data selection. Base releases such as 2.08 can receive periodic updates;
    dated selectors do not promise immutable archived snapshots.
    The site's /.well-known/api-catalog provides machine-readable discovery;
    HTTP Link headers advertise the api-catalog and service-desc relations.
servers:
  - url: https://scop.berkeley.edu/api/v1
tags:
  - {name: metadata}
  - {name: search}
  - {name: releases}
  - {name: nodes}
  - {name: pdb}
  - {name: sequences}
  - {name: astral}
  - {name: downloads}
paths:
  /:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getServiceIndex
      summary: Service metadata and canonical endpoint hints
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceIndex'}
  /openapi.yaml:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getOpenApiYaml
      summary: OpenAPI document
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
  /levels:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: listLevels
      summary: SCOP hierarchy levels
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/LevelsResponse'}
  /releases:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: listReleases
      summary: List public SCOP/SCOPe releases
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ReleasesResponse'}
  /releases/current:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getCurrentRelease
      summary: Current public release, including latest periodic update label where applicable
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /releases/{release}:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getRelease
      summary: Public release metadata and current periodic update label
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchCurrentRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in the current release
      description: >
        Uses materialized API search tables. This endpoint does not run broad
        MySQL full-text or leading-wildcard searches. Use it for discovery,
        then fetch exact release-scoped node/PDB endpoints for interpretation.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /downloads:
    get:
      tags: [downloads]
      operationId: listCurrentDownloads
      summary: Static download manifest for the current release
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/root:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getReleaseRoot
      summary: Root node for a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in a specific release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/resolve/{identifier}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: resolveIdentifier
      summary: Resolve a public SCOPe identifier in a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - name: identifier
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ResolveResponse'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getNodeBySunid
      summary: Node by public SUNID
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/parents:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidParents
      summary: Node parent lineage
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/LineageOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/children:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidChildren
      summary: Seek-paginated child nodes
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/ChildrenOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/annotations:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidAnnotations
      summary: Comments, inconsistencies, repeats, and xrefs
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/AnnotationsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/images:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidImages
      summary: Thumbnail and larger static images for a node
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/ImagesOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/homology:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidHomology
      summary: Homology scope and warnings for a node
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:

get:
      tags: [chains, hits]
      operationId: getChainHits
      summary: Sequence and structure matches from a PDB chain to SCOPe domains
      description: >-
        Results describe the requested chain; there is no automatic representative
        substitution. cluster_representative (under chain or subject) supplies
        release-specific representative links and local sequence identity/coverage.
        Follow those links explicitly for representative evidence, especially when
        the requested chain has no stored FATCAT hits. Do not transfer coordinates
        or classifications from the representative to the requested chain.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/chainIdentifier'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/hitLimit'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/HitsOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/chains/{chain}/sequence-hits:
    get:
      tags: [chains, hits]
      operationId: getChainSequenceHits
      summary: Ranked sequence matches from a PDB chain to SCOPe domains
      description: >-
        Results describe the requested chain; there is no automatic representative
        substitution. cluster_representative (under chain or subject) supplies
        release-specific representative links and local sequence identity/coverage.
        Follow those links explicitly for representative evidence, especially when
        the requested chain has no stored FATCAT hits. Do not transfer coordinates
        or classifications from the representative to the requested chain.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/chainIdentifier'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/hitLimit'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SequenceHitsOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/chains/{chain}/structure-hits:
    get:
      tags: [chains, hits]
      operationId: getChainStructureHits
      summary: Ranked FATCAT structure matches from a PDB chain to SCOPe domains
      description: >-
        Results describe the requested chain; there is no automatic representative
        substitution. cluster_representative (under chain or subject) supplies
        release-specific representative links and local sequence identity/coverage.
        Follow those links explicitly for representative evidence, especially when
        the requested chain has no stored FATCAT hits. Do not transfer coordinates
        or classifications from the representative to the requested chain.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/chainIdentifier'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/hitLimit'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/StructureHitsOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/chains/{chain}/coordinates:
    get:
      tags: [chains]
      operationId: getChainCoordinates
      summary: Chain-only PDB coordinates from the SCOPe local PDB snapshot
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/chainIdentifier'}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: PDB coordinate records for the selected chain
          content:
            chemical/x-pdb:
              schema: {type: string}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/pdb:
    get:
      tags: [pdb]
      operationId: listPdb
      summary: Compact seek-paginated PDB index classified in a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/PdbListOk'}
  /releases/{release}/pdb/{code}:
    get:
      tags: [pdb]
      operationId: getPdb
      summary: Compact PDB summary
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/pdbCode'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/PdbOk'}
  /releases/{release}/pdb/{code}/coordinates:
    get:
      tags: [pdb]
      operationId: getPdbCoordinates
      summary: Complete PDB coordinates from the SCOPe local PDB snapshot
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/pdbCode'}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Decompressed PDB coordinate records for the complete entry
          content:
            chemical/x-pdb:
              schema: {type: string}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/pdb/{code}/chains:
    get:
      tags: [pdb]
      operationId: getPdbChains
      summary: Chains and classified domains for a PDB entry
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/pdbCode'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/PdbChainsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/pdb/{code}/domains:
    get:
      tags: [pdb]
      operationId: getPdbDomains
      summary: Classified SCOPe domains for a PDB entry
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/pdbCode'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/PdbDomainsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/pdb/{code}/heterogens:
    get:
      tags: [pdb]
      operationId: getPdbHeterogens
      summary: Heterogens for a PDB entry
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/pdbCode'}
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
  /releases/{release}/pdb/{code}/quality:
    get:
      tags: [pdb, astral]
      operationId: getPdbQuality
      summary: SPACI/AEROSPACI quality for a PDB entry
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/pdbCode'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/QualityOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/pdb/{code}/revisions:
    get:
      tags: [pdb]
      operationId: getPdbRevisions
      summary: PDB revision dates for a PDB entry
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/pdbCode'}
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
  /releases/{release}/astral/quality:
    get:
      tags: [astral]
      operationId: listAstralQuality
      summary: Paginated release-wide SPACI/AEROSPACI rows
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/QualityListOk'}
  /releases/{release}/downloads:
    get:
      tags: [downloads]
      operationId: listReleaseDownloads
      summary: Static download manifest for a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/parseable-files:
    get:
      tags: [downloads]
      operationId: listParseableFiles
      summary: Parseable SCOP/SCOPe file manifest for a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/astral/files:
    get:
      tags: [astral, downloads]
      operationId: listAstralFiles
      summary: ASTRAL static file manifest for a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/astral/raf:
    get:
      tags: [astral, downloads]
      operationId: listAstralRafFiles
      summary: RAF static file manifest for a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/astral/pdbstyle:
    get:
      tags: [astral, downloads]
      operationId: listAstralPdbstyleFiles
      summary: ASTRAL PDB-style coordinate archive manifest for a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/astral/subsets:
    get:
      tags: [astral, downloads]
      operationId: listAstralSubsets
      summary: ASTRAL representative subset static file manifest
      description: >
        This endpoint lists static subset files. It intentionally does not
        expand subset membership from SQL because the subset tables are large
        and require additional indexing/materialization for cheap public JSON
        traversal.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
components:
  parameters:
    releasePath:
      name: release
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: {type: string, examples: ['2.08', '1.75']}
      description: Public SCOP/SCOPe release selector such as 2.08.
    releaseQuery:
      name: release
      in: query
      required: false
      schema: {type: string, examples: ['2.08', '1.75']}
      description: Public release selector; defaults to the current release.
    searchQuery:
      name: q
      in: query
      required: true
      schema: {type: string, maxLength: 256}
      examples:
        sunid: {value: 'sunid:46456'}
        pdbChain: {value: '1ux8A'}
        name: {value: histone}
    searchMode:
      name: mode
      in: query
      schema: {type: string, enum: [auto, identifier, token, prefix], default: auto}
      description: >
        auto searches exact public identifiers plus exact precomputed word and
        phrase tokens. identifier restricts to public identifiers and accessions.
        token searches exact normalized word and phrase tokens. prefix searches
        precomputed prefix tokens and requires one normalized token of at least
        three characters.
    limit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 500, default: 100}
    cursor:
      name: cursor
      in: query
      schema: {type: string}
      description: Opaque seek-pagination cursor returned by the previous page.
    sunid:
      name: sunid
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: {type: integer}
      description: Public SCOP/SCOPe SUNID.
    sid:
      name: sid
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: {type: string}
      description: Public SCOP/SCOPe domain identifier such as d4as4b_.
    sccs:
      name: sccs
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: {type: string}
      description: Public SCOP/SCOPe classification such as e.7.1.1.
    pdbCode:
      name: code
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: {type: string, pattern: '^[0-9][A-Za-z0-9]{3}$'}
    pdbChain:
      name: chain
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: {type: string, pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9]$'}
      description: One case-sensitive PDB chain character.
    sequenceSource:
      name: source
      in: query
      schema: {type: string, enum: [seqres, atom], default: seqres}
      description: Return full declared residues or residues observed in ATOM records.
    domainSequenceStyle:
      name: style
      in: query
      schema: {type: string, enum: [genetic, original], default: genetic}
      description: Use genetic-domain boundaries or the original SCOP boundaries.
    sequenceFormat:
      name: format
      in: query
      schema: {type: string, enum: [json, fasta], default: json}
    alphaFoldModel:
      name: model
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: {type: string, pattern: '^AF-[A-Za-z0-9]+-F[0-9]+$', examples: [AF-P69905-F1]}
    chainIdentifier:
      name: chain
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Four-character PDB code followed by one chain character.
      schema: {type: string, pattern: '^[0-9][A-Za-z0-9]{4}$', examples: [1akeA]}
    hitLimit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      description: Maximum returned hits of each kind.
      schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 100}
    candidateLimit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      description: Maximum returned candidate models.
      schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 20}
    candidateMinRegions:
      name: min_regions
      in: query

item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q016_pdb_1acc_domain_split","answer":"In SCOP 1.75, PDB 1acc chain A was represented as a single domain, d1acca_ (SUNID 43828), covering 1acc A: and classified as f.11.1.1: class f, fold f.11 Anthrax protective antigen, superfamily f.11.1, family f.11.1.1. The current SCOPe release is 2.08, and the split first appears in the checked releases at SCOPe 2.04: the old whole-chain domain is replaced by two domains. d1acca2 (SUNID 238522), residues A:14-225, is b.179.1.1: class b All beta proteins, fold b.179 Anthrax protective antigen N-terminal-like, superfamily b.179.1 PA14-like, family b.179.1.1 PA14. d1acca1 (SUNID 238521), residues A:226-735, is f.60.1.1: class f Membrane and cell surface proteins and peptides, fold/superfamily/family Anthrax protective antigen C-terminal-like. SCOPe 2.01-2.03 still show the old single d1acca_ definition, while 2.04-2.08 show the two-domain definition. Biologically, the revision means the 1.75 entry treated a multidomain chain as one evolutionary unit, but newer SCOPe separates two evolutionary modules with different class/fold/superfamily/family assignments. Homology should therefore be inferred domain-by-domain: family and superfamily assignments support homology within each module, while fold is weaker structural similarity and class is not a homology assertion. Do not transfer homology, function, template coverage, or representative status from the old f.11.1.1 whole-chain annotation to both parts of the protein. In searches, split or interpret hits by residue span: matches around A:14-225 support the PA14/b.179 module, and matches around A:226-735 support the f.60 C-terminal module. Whole-chain hits or hits to the release-specific cluster representative 3tewA may be useful external search evidence, but the API explicitly treats representative links as evidence to follow rather than classifications or coordinates to attribute directly to 1accA; template use should check residue coverage and domain correspondence rather than assuming one full-chain homologous template.","evidence_used":["/api/v1","/api/v1/openapi.yaml","/api/v1/releases/current","/api/v1/releases","/api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1acc/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1acc/domains","/api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.01/pdb/1acc/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.02/pdb/1acc/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.03/pdb/1acc/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.04/pdb/1acc/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.05/pdb/1acc/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.06/pdb/1acc/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.07/pdb/1acc/domains","/api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/homology","/api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/chains/1accA","/api/v1/releases/1.75/chains/1accA","/api/v1/releases/2.08/chains/1accA/hits?limit=5","/api/v1/releases/2.08/chains/3tewA/hits?limit=5"]}]}
